title: Personal Services Plan — Billed Minutes When Delivered Time Differs from Booked Time
content:
When an hourly charge for a delivered visit under the Personal Services Plan is re-rated, the visit's delivered minutes are billed as follows: where fewer minutes were delivered than were booked, the delivered minutes are rounded down to a whole number of billing increments; where more minutes were delivered than were booked, the billed minutes are the booked minutes; otherwise the delivered minutes are rounded up to the next billing increment.

The booked minutes are the booked hours on the visit's service order multiplied by 60; the delivered minutes are those recorded when the order was completed. The billing increment is 15 minutes on every tier of the Personal Services Plan. The billed minutes so found are the visit's billable time before it is expressed in hours.

## Decision table

| Delivered minutes compared with booked minutes | Billed minutes |
|---|---|
| Fewer than booked | Delivered minutes rounded down to a whole number of 15-minute increments |
| More than booked | The booked minutes |
| Equal to booked | Delivered minutes rounded up to the next 15-minute increment |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical visits)

For a visit booked for 1.5 hours, that is 90 booked minutes:

| Delivered minutes | Comparison | Billed minutes |
|---|---|---|
| 89 | Fewer than 90 | 75 |
| 76 | Fewer than 90 | 75 |
| 74 | Fewer than 90 | 60 |
| 90 | Equal | 90 |
| 91 | More than 90 | 90 |
| 130 | More than 90 | 90 |

For a visit booked for 1 hour (60 minutes) and delivered in 44 minutes, the billed minutes are 30: the delivered minutes are fewer than booked and 44 rounded down to whole 15-minute increments is 30.

## Points of reading

**Does a short visit ever bill a part-increment?** No. A visit delivered in fewer minutes than booked bills only the whole increments delivered.

**Does a visit that ran over bill the extra time?** No. Where more minutes were delivered than were booked, the billed minutes are the booked minutes.
